notes.title: Caravan Update – Very Soon!
notes.content:
[h1]🌅 Sunset Motel – Caravan Update Devlog [/h1]

We’re in the final testing phase! 🚀
That’s right — the Caravan Update is almost at the finish line. We’re doing the very last internal checks, and there’s really just a little time left before we can share it with you. ⏳💛

To celebrate, we’ve prepared a small devlog. This way, you can see not only what’s planned but also what we’re already testing in-game.

[h3]🚐 Caravan Interior Design[/h3]

With brand-new furniture, flooring, and decoration options, you’ll be able to completely renovate abandoned caravans.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/87c1cec92aeb149e8b80710b34c5ee6e2c558ac2.png[/img]

[h3]🛻 Caravan Exterior Overhaul[/h3]

Rusty bodies, broken windows, faded paint — restore them all and give your caravan a fresh, new look!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/ce828d00b6575ceac69421999cfa0e781455c6ae.png[/img]

[h3]🎥 Outdoor Cinema[/h3]

You can now set up an open-air cinema at your motel!
Guests will enjoy movies under the stars, while you showcase your own style through decoration.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/45e34261c97bf9e97646aa1dcdf71c494ed53e52.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/56d20ef98fa3835ca1b33d08642f98acf88c2fd5.png[/img]
[h3]🔧 Internal Testing & New Mechanics[/h3]

Right now, the team is testing these features. From performance optimizations to fine-tuning new mechanics, we’re making sure everything runs smoothly.
In short: the update is almost here! 🚀

[h3]🎬 What’s Next
[/h3]
Very soon, we’ll be announcing the release date. Until then, enjoy these previews as a taste of what’s coming.

Thank you,
The Sunset Motel Team 💛

notes.title: Caravans Are Coming!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello motel residents![/h1][p]We’re getting closer and closer to the final stretch of the Caravan Update — and while it’s not quite ready for release yet, we just couldn’t wait any longer to share a glimpse with you.

Before we wrap things up, we’ve prepared a short preview with some fresh visuals and videos to give you a taste of what’s coming. From full renovation mechanics to cozy campgrounds, there’s a lot to explore — so grab a coffee and take a scroll through what we’ve been building for you! ☕🚐

But these aren’t just decorative. When you find them, they’re abandoned, dirty, and broken.
As a player, you’ll:

-Strip rotten wall parts

-Clean up the mess

-Insulate with foam

-Set up water & power systems

-And finally decorate the entire interior as you wish![/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/33d3086626a6df3b605a691ded047bf94690237f.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/981bf928f7ec7689f39682e24f856cd7c3588061.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/2be8099fdc3afec6a1c114feb971eb60367e0d5c.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/6bd5da3394710f47be49971b1e2c2a6d586fdedd.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/a57760d8c8292c5ba7e87982e4c433534dc5a353.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/2b98ce2eabf3bbb52993fafe908f3decaf5808a0.gif"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h1]🧼 Before & After – See the Transformation[/h1][p]Every caravan starts off as a wreck…
…But you’ll turn it into a cozy, personalized mini-home.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/ccc1a18f833e7c839e7ed1bc8898e2eb13f3f9dc.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/16ac79b436a9b4280bf8fdbce77eeaa49613d6c0.png"][/img]
[/p][h1]🪑 250+ New Items & Floorings![/h1][p]With this update, we’re adding over 150 new furniture and flooring options.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/dd4725319f459cd6afc9b60cacde25ca4d95a3a6.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/29052cf093afc26b0a9ca3b4840b0b21cf7838b3.png"][/img]

🧰 We hope you enjoy this little preview of what’s to come.
Thank you so much for your patience and incredible support — it means the world to us.
We can’t wait to welcome you back with the Caravan Update very soon! 🚐💛



[/p]

notes.title: Sunset Motel's upcoming major update!
notes.content:
[h1]Attention all guests of Sunset Motel![/h1]

[h2]🛻 Caravan Update – Full Feature Breakdown[/h2]
The Sunset Motel universe is expanding — now with fully customizable caravans!
This major update brings a new layer of gameplay depth, creativity, and automation to your motel grounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/3384418f184daaf2b0a869121ba1d1f18c7cfedf.png[/img]

[h2]🔧 Caravan System[/h2]
Buy and place up to 10 caravans right across from your motel

Repair broken parts, connect electricity, and keep everything in top condition

Decorate each caravan interior with 100+ unique furniture and styles

Rent them out to guests and increase your revenue

A buffet area will be added in the middle for guest interaction

A new caravan workshop/shop will be available to buy parts and tools

[h2]🎨 Decoration[/h2]
We’re bringing 30+ new assets in 3 key categories:

🪣 Paint

📜 Wallpaper

🪵 Parquet & flooring

Use them to personalize your caravan interiors with full freedom and flair!

[h2]🤖 Automation & Staff[/h2]
Make your life easier with new features:

Fire extinguisher system (for safety events)

Automated staff for repairing damaged items

A remote grocery ordering machine so you never run out of supplies!

🧡 As always, thank you for your feedback and continued support! This update wouldn’t be possible without our community.

notes.title: HOTFIX #2
notes.content:
[h1]Attention all guests of Sunset Motel![/h1]

We’ve been paying close attention to your reports and comments, and once again we’ve rolled up our sleeves to make Sunset Motel an even smoother and cozier experience. This hotfix brings several fixes to improve stability, visuals, and overall gameplay comfort. Here's what’s been addressed:

🖼️ The issue with some textures not loading properly — especially on graphics cards with 4GB VRAM — has been resolved. Your motel should now look sharp and vibrant even on limited hardware.

🍺 A bug where the bar’s UI would stay open and not close properly has been fixed. You can now serve drinks without UI clutter.

📱 An issue where the tablet wouldn’t function in certain situations has been fixed. You should now be able to interact with it reliably.

🚿 A strange bug where the bathroom would merge with the main floor layout in some rooms has been corrected. No more layout chaos!

🆘 A new feature has been added — if your character gets stuck, you can now press ESC to automatically recover and get back to the motel.

🧼 Customers getting blocked at the door when decorative carpets were placed in front of entrances? Fixed! They can now freely walk in no matter your interior design skills.

⚙️ And finally, we’ve made general performance improvements across the game to ensure smoother gameplay for all players.

Thank you once again for your continued support and feedback — it truly helps us make Sunset Motel the warmest stop on the road. 🛎️💛
Stay tuned for more features, polish, and updates soon!

notes.title: HOTFIX #1
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Sunset Motel residents![/h1]

We’ve been closely listening to your feedback and have been working behind the scenes to fix some issues and improve your stay. Here’s what’s been addressed in this hotfix:

1. 🧳 The rare issue where the suitcase wouldn’t arrive has been fixed.  
2. 🍷 The alcohol serving task at the bar has been made more clear and user-friendly.  
3. 🍽️ A rare bug where food wasn’t being served has been resolved.  
4. 🇪🇸 Some words in the Spanish localization have been corrected.  
5. 🛠️ General optimizations were made to improve FPS in certain areas.  
6. 🚗 Fixed a bug where the car purchase button in the mechanic shop wasn’t working.  
7. 🧍‍♂️ Fixed broken customer models in medium and low graphic settings.  
8. 🌑 Corrected the overly dark shadows on medium settings.  
9. 🌿 Grass rendering issues in low settings have been resolved.  
10. 🗺️ Fixed a bug where players could get stuck outside the map by accident.

Thanks for playing and for all your helpful reports — you’re helping make Sunset Motel the coziest roadside stop in town. 🛎️💛  
Stay tuned, more improvements and features are on the way!

After over a year and a half of passion, creativity, and countless cups of coffee, we’re so excited to finally welcome you to Sunset Motel — it’s now officially LIVE on Steam! 🛎️✨

notes.title: Sunset Motel Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[h1]🏨 Sunset Motel Officially Opens on April 18, 2025! 🌇[/h1]

Hello Sunset Motel Residents! Are your bags packed? Got your keys ready? Because Sunset Motel is officially opening its doors on April 18, 2025! ✨
After months of development, countless cups of coffee, bug fixes, and your amazing feedback, we’re finally in the home stretch.
Now it’s time to share this world with you. 🎉

[previewyoutube=OSFobOT5-jg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]What’s Waiting for You?[/h1]
A brand-new staff system: From bellboys to fitness coaches, your motel is more alive than ever!

New businesses: Car wash service, relaxing sauna, redesigned bar, and a customizable pool area just for your guests.

Bring nostalgia into your rooms with special quests from the antique dealer.

A packed experience with a full-featured gym and new service machines.

Enhanced decoration tools, more interactive elements, and surprise mini-games!

New languages, new details, and so much more!

💬 We’re truly grateful for your interest, feedback, and patience during the Prologue.
What makes Sunset Motel so special... is you.
This isn’t just a management game — it’s a story you helped create.
And in every corner of the motel, your presence can be felt.


[h1]🙏 With love, from Efkey Studios[/h1]
Thank you for believing in us, for waiting for our game, and for always keeping the motel light on.
Now pack your bags—because check-in time at Sunset Motel is just around the corner.
Your key is ready. 🛎️✨

[h2]Sunset Motel Development Team :)[/h2]

[h1]Due to an unexpected event, we are postponing the release date a little from April 16th to April 18th, but don't worry, we are coming full speed on April 18th :)[/h1]

notes.title: Devlog #5 - January
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2616140/Sunset_Motel/

[h1]Hello Sunset Motel Residents! 🌟🏨[/h1]

With the release of our game just around the corner, we would like to tell you about some exciting developments. Thank you so much for supporting us during this process! 🙏😊 We are working on developing a great game that will be worth the wait. Now, let's take a look at the innovations together:

[h1]New Employees 🧑‍💼🧑‍👩‍💼[/h1]
As our motel expands, new job opportunities have emerged and you will now be able to hire new employees to run the motel. This innovation will allow you to get your work done faster and more efficiently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/96c81d0a8937e40c43ac541d9a5578b401f552b6.png[/img]
[h1](Bellhop , Bartender , Barwaiter , Chef , Receptionist , Motelwaiter , Gymcoach)[/h1]

[h1]Sauna 🧧🚰[/h1]
You will be able to open your sauna to offer your customers an extra relaxation area and earn extra income. This new feature will increase the appeal of your motel and ensure that your customers have a pleasant time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/3578ca796fec79c1217e8d0c62e7fbcd10e87e79.png[/img]

[h1]Car Wash Business 🚗🛄[/h1]
You will be able to set up a washing and drying station for cars passing by our motel. This business will provide you with extra income and expand the range of services offered by your motel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/bc3ded0b17a70402729fa01c6f8eac013aaf2f4a.png[/img]

[h1]New Bar 🍻🎉[/h1]
We have redesigned our bar and added an extra mini game. Now you will have more fun at the bar

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/d84cdb2d9d262d11e8d769922b7b861476eb54d7.png[/img]

[h1]Bugs 🔧[/h1]
We have fixed many bugs and added new features to the game based on your feedback. We are constantly working together with you to provide a better gaming experience.

[h1]Languages ​​📚🌐[/h1]
We have expanded our language support and added Arabic to the game. Now we can reach a wider range of players and make Sunset Motel enjoyable for everyone.

With these exciting innovations, we aim to further enhance your Sunset Motel experience. Your support is very valuable to us and we can't wait to share the full game with you. Stay tuned for announcements!

[h2]Thanks, 🙏😊
Sunset Motel Development Team :)[/h2]

notes.title: Devlog #4 - September
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2616140/Sunset_Motel/


[h1]Greetings, Sunset Motel Residents![/h1]

We’re thrilled to extend our deepest thanks for your wonderful feedback on the Sunset Motel Prologue. Your reviews and support have been incredibly valuable as we work tirelessly on the full release. We're excited to announce that the full version of the game is on the horizon, and we can’t wait for you to experience it in all its glory!


[h1] Pool Facility: Dive into Fun![/h1]

We’re introducing a brand-new Pool Facility that’s set to enhance your motel experience. With the new pool, you can design the perfect relaxation spot for your guests. Create a customized pool area and offer refreshing drinks to guests lounging by the water. It’s not just a pool; it’s a place where your guests can unwind and enjoy themselves. Whether it’s a serene swim or a lively poolside gathering, this new feature is sure to add a splash of fun to your motel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/e95207d79c3c6f04485313493be65a09d331d04e.png[/img]

[h1] Gym Facility: Boost Your Motel’s Appeal![/h1]

Get ready to break a sweat with our new Gym Facility! We’re adding a state-of-the-art gym to your motel, allowing you to design and manage a fitness space for your guests. Set up exercise equipment and hire a professional trainer to ensure your guests get the best workout experience. This new feature not only boosts your motel’s attractiveness but also opens up new revenue streams. Keep your guests fit and happy while earning extra income!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/f9ca1c4a57971a1ef1f0a30e76d942f9cfcdef3e.png[/img]

 [h1]Antique Shop Revamp: Discover Hidden Treasures![/h1]

We’ve given the Antique Shop a major overhaul. Now, you can engage in additional tasks and challenges that will allow you to acquire unique antique furniture for your motel. These antiques can enhance the ambiance of your rooms and increase their value. Dive into new side quests to find rare items that will make your motel stand out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/e864115a78b56463956aae90ca6e4350c53e1823.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/ed4a7eb88182379b2c9de7e41933ed02d3ab9a77.png[/img]



[h1] Mechanic Shop: Your Car and More![/h1]

The Mechanic Shop is now a vital part of your motel’s ecosystem. Beyond routine repairs, you’ll have the opportunity to take on side quests that can reward you with a special car. Use the shop not only for essential repairs but also to expand your vehicle collection and enhance your gameplay experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/ba950c9f54c64388b76095e342bcd4f4887f6a94.png[/img]

[h1]New Drivable Cars :)[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/8af4444448fc5f64a1f47d0f17aec792781edae2.png[/img]

[h1] New Service Machines: More Choices for Your Guests![/h1]

We’re expanding your service options with new machines that allow you to offer a wider variety of food items. From delicious desserts and crispy fries to creamy milkshakes, these new machines will help you cater to diverse tastes and keep your guests satisfied.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/2a6144727945e2c5b26ecc0ac467ca45075d020a.png[/img]


We’ve been busy crafting these exciting updates to make Sunset Motel even better. Rest assured that we’re dedicated to delivering a rich and engaging experience. Your continued support means the world to us, and we can’t wait to share the full game with you.

Thank you once again for your support and feedback on the Prologue. Stay tuned for more updates and announcements about the full release!


[h3]Thank you, Sunset Motel Development Team :)[/h3]

notes.title: Sunset Motel Demo Launches Tomorrow !
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Sunset Motel Players,[/h1]

We’re excited to announce that the demo version of "Sunset Motel" is launching tomorrow ! Be sure to add it to your wishlist to get notified as soon as it's available.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2616140/Sunset_Motel/

[h2] Experience Sunset Motel [/h2]

Dive into the world of Sunset Motel with our demo, giving you a taste of the exciting renovation and management gameplay. Keep in mind, this is a demo version, so while it offers a glimpse into the full experience, many features and areas will be expanded in the final release.

[h2] What’s Included in the Demo: [/h2]

-Basic room renovation tasks
-Furniture placement and decoration
-Cleaning and maintenance activities
-Customer service duties (e.g., food delivery, laundry)
-And much more to explore!

[h2] What to Expect in the Full Game: [/h2] 

-Advanced decoration and renovation options
-Expanded customer service features
-A wider variety of furniture and decor
-Engaging story events
-And numerous other enhancements!
-Lots of new facilities

[h2] Your Feedback Matters: [/h2]

notes.title: Devlog #3 - April
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2616140/Sunset_Motel/


[h1]Greetings, Sunset Motel Residents![/h1]

[h3]We're excited to showcase this week's new updates to you. We've been hard at work enhancing your motel experience, and we can't wait for you to dive in and explore all the latest features.[/h3]

[h2]Thief Capture Mechanic Updated.More Exciting Chases:[/h2]

We've revamped the thief capture mechanic to make chasing down criminals even more exhilarating. Get ready for added thrills and unexpected twists as you pursue thieves through Sunset Motel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/cc21be41ec0850020764e2fa16fd89517a3c84ed.gif[/img]

[h2]Stocking Food in the Fridge:[/h2]

Now, when you purchase food from the market, you have the option to store it in the fridge. When guests request meals, you can easily access the fridge and provide them with delicious dishes they'll love.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/444488deee6a0fd7c8cc8bf1b138e513dd105f9c.gif[/img]

[h2]Service Mechanics Upgrade: Taking Charge of Services Like a Pro:[/h2]

We've introduced a significant upgrade to the service mechanics. From now on, you'll have full control over service tasks just like you handle tools. Enjoy a smoother and more immersive experience as you manage various services throughout the motel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/31aeb24dbb40f3563db259a5c690fdc7eb41941b.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/38115c776827c2c0080e4ac6786444b681186cda.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/4c0691bf3cf759d4bde83abd1d197996a6a8c476.gif[/img]

[h2]Realistic Combat with NPCs:[/h2]

Experience more lifelike encounters with NPCs as we've enhanced their physics to provide a more realistic fighting experience. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/59e0eef3258dc90e29b0240da9981fd970712e3f.gif[/img]

We're constantly striving to make Sunset Motel the best it can be, and your feedback plays a crucial role in shaping our updates. We appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you in the next update!

[h3]Thank you, Sunset Motel Development Team :)[/h3]

notes.title: Devlog #2 - February
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2616140/Sunset_Motel/


[h1]Hello, Motel Managers![/h1]

[h3]Welcome dear motel managers! Today we are here to share with you the latest developments and new features of our game.[/h3]

[h2]Find Hidden Codes on the Map:[/h2]

With our new feature, you will now find hidden safes on the motel map. You can earn money by collecting clues to unlock the codes of these safes. However, be careful, as each safe has a different code, and you will need to make a logical combination based on the clues you find.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/53b41f12e01ba988396c73b4d798f4d2afb068a0.gif[/img]

[h2]Enjoy Black Jack at the Bar:[/h2]

In the bar on the map, you can now play an exciting game of Black Jack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/6caaf9ff4e35815c4f4d77009a5dc9062f46ba70.gif[/img]

[h2]Fast Service for Dirty Laundry:[/h2]

It is now your duty to wash your guests' dirty laundry. With the newly added laundry washing feature as a service, you can increase customer satisfaction, earn additional income, and satisfy the customers in your motel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/c643d13124bda5851893c0012ee86f120739fa60.gif[/img]

[h2]Food Market:[/h2]

You can buy food from a market near your motel and offer various flavors to your guests. By shopping at the market, you can improve your menu and increase your income by catering to the tastes of your guests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/14761afdba8541b6868b435b22e817b5602a4eeb.gif[/img]

[h2]Emergency: Car Fire:[/h2]

As a challenging part of motel management, it's time to test your ability to deal with unexpected situations. Now, there could be a fire in your car. It is important to always have a fire extinguisher with you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/7e5d57a9db8e16aef76f8998b8b2d8c08aee22cc.gif[/img]

With this month's developments, we have further enriched your motel management. Remember, your feedback is valuable and helps us improve our game. See you in the next update!

[h3]Thank you, Sunset Motel Development Team :)[/h3]

notes.title: Devlog #1 - January
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2616140/Sunset_Motel/


[h1]Hello Motel Managers![/h1]

[h3]Welcome, in this devlog, we're excited to present you with our latest enhancements and additions. We're introducing a comprehensive update filled with brand-new features and improvements.[/h3]

[h2]Enhanced Vehicle Controls:[/h2]

We've overhauled our vehicle mechanics from the ground up to make in-game transportation more enjoyable. Now, with smoother controls, you can freely navigate around the motel and explore every corner with ease.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/038cd6d9b276f9615cf0af2c62826ecc7db91dfc.gif[/img]


[h2]Rainy Weather:[/h2]

Introducing a new weather feature to the game – rainy days! Rain will add an even more immersive touch to the game atmosphere, providing your guests with a different experience. Grab your umbrella because now you can enhance the allure of your motel with the charm of rain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/19df4f2aa228d8946ff6a83d5021cea453b1b84c.gif[/img]

[h2]New Bar Area:[/h2]

We've elevated the entertainment level in your motel! A brand-new bar area has been added. Players can participate in drink contests, play card games, and create unforgettable moments in this space. Your guests now have more options for a delightful evening.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/51f388a7d5b7b5e43f44358b6968dc50b53f1c5b.png[/img]

[h2]Updated Skill System:[/h2]

Skill development is now more enjoyable than ever! We've revamped our skill system and introduced brand-new skills. Players will find even more enjoyment at each skill level, mastering motel management. Develop your skills and take your establishment to new heights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/eb747330aa05d796b379c62ffb9fc1c699205460.gif[/img]

[h2]Cleaning Mechanics:[/h2]

Rooms can now get messy, and it's up to you to use your cleaning skills to restore them to their original state. Your success in maintaining cleanliness will increase guest satisfaction and make your establishment more appealing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/088b1f70c1c52eb21b4d1a44bce68d386b6a5306.gif[/img]

[h2]New Upgrade Options:[/h2]

Thinking of expanding your motel business? We've got you covered! We now offer upgrade options for a spa, dining area, and other facilities. Turn your motel into an even more attractive destination for guests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44794918/852027d2c51f4264d17566f046d9d13ae38f1c31.gif[/img]

[h3]Thank you, Sunset Motel Development Team :)[/h3]
